searchText: do you have an address for them I can verify non-type 2 tx? The problem is that they submit a contract call (signed by MetaMask) and in the calldata is a `gasPrice` parameter. In their contract they do something along the lines of `require(GAS_PRICE >= gasPrice)`. The `GAS_PRICE` opcode returns the effective gas price for the transaction (base fee + priority fee). This means that if you set priority fee to 1 and max fee to 100 and then you pay 26, the GAS_PRICE opcode will return 26. Their stupid contract then immediately fails because you didn't use the "gas price" they suggested you use which was 30 (or whatever). We've just released an update that raises the maxFee multiplier, will be monitoring inclusion time of transactions to see if this has the desired effect, and continue tweaking until a reasonable inclusion time is reached.
